title: Community Map 3D Globe with Member Pins (No External Map Provider)

requirements.summary: Replace the 2D CommunityMapPanel map with an interactive, Earth-like 3D globe (rotate + zoom) while preserving the existing Community Map page framework and selection UX.
acceptanceCriteria: The Community Map page route (`/community-map`) remains the same and continues to render the existing header, member directory cards, and stats panel.
The map area is rendered as a 3D globe (Earth-like) instead of the current flat image `/assets/generated/world-map.dim_1600x900.png`.
Users can rotate the globe (drag) and zoom in/out (mouse wheel / trackpad), producing a Google Earth-like interaction feel.
The existing member selection UX is preserved: selecting a member on the map highlights them and shows the selected-member details card overlay; clicking the X clears selection.
Clicking a member card in the directory still selects the same member on the globe and brings the user back to the map area (current scroll-to-top behavior is preserved).

file_operations.description: Replace the current 2D image-based map rendering and 2D pan/zoom handling with a 3D globe panel that supports drag-to-rotate and wheel/trackpad zoom, while keeping the existing card layout, zoom/reset controls placement, and selected-member details overlay behavior intact.

Create a dedicated 3D globe component responsible for initializing and rendering the Earth-like globe (WebGL/canvas), handling rotate and zoom interactions, and exposing selection callbacks to the parent panel.

Add a hook to manage globe interaction state (rotation/zoom), unify mouse + touch drag gestures, and provide imperative helpers for zoom in/out/reset to keep the existing UI button behavior consistent.

requirements.summary: Render globe pins for members with coordinates from getCommunityMapProfiles() and allow pin click selection with distinct selected state.
acceptanceCriteria: For every `CommunityMapProfile` with non-null `coordinates`, a visible pin/marker is shown on the globe at the correct approximate location.
Clicking a pin selects/deselects the corresponding member (toggle behavior consistent with current map marker behavior).
Selected member pin/marker has a clearly distinct visual state (e.g., scale/ring/brightness) compared to unselected pins.
Pins are not rendered for profiles where `coordinates` is null/undefined.
No external map services (Google Maps/Earth APIs) are required for the map to function.

file_operations.description: Implement pin/marker rendering for each profile with `coordinates` by converting latitude/longitude to positions on the sphere surface, projecting to screen space (or rendering directly in WebGL), and enabling click-based hit detection that toggles selection and applies a distinct selected visual state.

Add utilities for converting latitude/longitude to sphere surface vectors and projecting to 2D screen coordinates (as needed) so markers appear at correct approximate globe locations and can be culled when on the far side of the globe.

Wire the existing `selectedMemberId` and `onSelectMember` behavior to the globe pin interactions so map selection, deselection, and selected-member details overlay continue to work identically to the current panel behavior.

requirements.summary: Use local static Earth texture assets from frontend/public/assets/generated for the globe surface (no backend texture fetching).
acceptanceCriteria: The globe surface uses the provided generated Earth texture asset(s) located under `frontend/public/assets/generated`.
All texture URLs are local static asset paths (e.g., `/assets/generated/...`) and load correctly in production builds.
The previous 2D map image is no longer required for the main globe rendering path.

file_operations.description: Add the generated high-resolution equirectangular Earth day texture asset as a static file at this exact path so the globe can load it locally.
Add the generated equirectangular Earth night lights texture asset as a static file at this exact path so the globe can load it locally.

Load and apply the globe surface textures from local static asset paths `frontend/public/assets/generated/earth-day-texture.dim_2048x1024.jpg` and `frontend/public/assets/generated/earth-night-texture.dim_2048x1024.jpg` (referenced via `/assets/generated/...`) without fetching textures through the backend, and ensure the old `/assets/generated/world-map.dim_1600x900.png` is not used in the main globe rendering path.

requirements.summary: Add a graceful fallback message inside the map card when 3D globe rendering cannot initialize (e.g., WebGL unavailable).
acceptanceCriteria: If 3D rendering cannot initialize, the map panel shows a clear English message indicating the interactive globe is unavailable on the device/browser.
The rest of the Community Map page (member directory and stats) remains usable even if the globe cannot render.

file_operations.description: Add a small hook/utility that detects whether WebGL initialization is likely to succeed (and optionally captures initialization errors) so the map panel can decide whether to render the interactive globe or a fallback message.
Render a fallback UI inside the existing map card area when WebGL/3D globe initialization fails (English user-facing message), while keeping the directory and stats panels unaffected and usable.
Ensure globe initialization failures are caught and reported back to the parent (or handled internally) so the parent can switch to the fallback UI instead of breaking the page.
